text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Now THAT'S what I call guts, babyyy!!
That's our Kitasan Blackkkk!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant, gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very muuuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her increasingly spirited running
is completely turning the crowd's attention in her favor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Through her run in this Tenno Sho (Spring),
Kitasan Black became a mighty trunk
beloved by all her fans."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's Trainer, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I want to talk to her. With one of the
――aces of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait... Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forgive me when you're already tired after the race. We'll speak briefly, and then I'll head right back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: “—First, let me offer my praise. Quite impressive. As of last year, tenacity was your only standout trait, but...”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Her run today was completely flawless throughout.
I felt a bottomless, immense potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black. You truly are an exceptional Umamusume, more than worthy of representing your generation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Thank you very much.
But, really...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why it feels all the more regrettable.
That Brusqueman couldn't run in last autumn's Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I was hoping we could settle things properly... for our final Classic showdown.
So, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we settle the score once and for all?
So that both of us can move forward with a clear conscience.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san...
With Brusqueman-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I want to run!
Back on the day of the Kikuka Sho, I... I was so torn...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to reclaim what was left behind, something huge!
With who I am now and who Brusque Man is now, clashing all our pent-up feelings together!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank goodness... They feel the same way.
Then let us make a move to grant that wish.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion.
Until next time, then—at Hanshin.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nigawa...? 
By Nigawa, do you mean... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin... Ah!
The Takarazuka Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was—the designation of the decisive battleground.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I thought maybe today would be the biggest climax of spring.
But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"An even bigger mountain! Next up is a showdown
with that Brusqueman at the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My blood surged with heat. A forgotten decisive battle is revived now, after half a year's time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And one more... Satono Diamond
was undeniably facing the greatest ordeal of her spring.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond is defeated in the Nippon Derby as well!
A narrow 2nd place finish!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The margin is an unbelievable... 8 centimeters! Just 8 centimeters!
She fell just short!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A thrown shoe... To think such trouble would happen
in an important race like this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Following the bad break at the Satsuki Sho...
Still, I won't lose... I won't lose, Kita-chan."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely break this jinx.
Even if it costs me my life."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Those 8 centimeters were part of my weakness too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Kitasan Black wasn't the only one
growing more dependable.
Satono Diamond was the same."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bearing the long-cherished wish of her family, the jewel's refined face twisted with fierce fighting spirit...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the fall—I will have her horseshoes reexamined.
We need to see if we can develop ones that can help avoid accidents even a little more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And I must check myself thoroughly as well.
Furthermore, what's more important than anything else is—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I need the strength to win even with a thrown shoe.
I must acquire the unshakeable power
to blow any jinx away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Dia-chan!
I'm going to take on just as big a hurdle myself.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"My opponent is an incredibly talented Umamusume.
But I won't lose! That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Watch me, Dia-chan! In the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two girls challenge the colossal wall standing in their way.
First up, Kitasan Black takes on the Takarazuka Kinen.
